task_title: 재료 CSV/nk/epsilon import, passive fitting, 원자료 출처·사용권·해시, fit band, 시간 이산화에 따른 n/k 오차, extrapolation 경고를 하나의 workflow로 묶는다

physics_configuration.public_table: tests/fixtures/materials/sio2_sellmeier_malitson1965.csv: 81 wavelengths from 0.4 to 2.0 um of n from the Sellmeier equation of Malitson, J. Opt. Soc. Am. 55, 1205 (1965) stated in the file header, k = 0
physics_configuration.synthetic_table: authored two-pole Lorentz permittivity (epsilon_inf 2.3; poles (1.7e15 rad/s, 4e30 rad^2/s^2, 2e14 rad/s) and (3e15, 2e30, 5e14)) at 61 wavelengths from 0.8 to 2.0 um, written as wavelength_nm or wavelength_um, epsilon_real, epsilon_imag text
physics_configuration.fit_options: max_poles 3, tolerance 1e-4 (SiO2); max_poles 2 or 3, tolerance 1e-6 or 1e-4, include_drude False (Lorentz); ADE-target fit at dt 4e-17 s on 0.9 to 1.9 um for the persistence test
physics_configuration.discretization: dt 5e-17 s and 2.5e-17 s over 0.4 to 2.0 um, 201 samples
physics_configuration.workbench: tests/ui/material-provenance.spec.js: import the SiO2 table with source and licence, fit, use, read the provenance and band panel, move the source to 2.5 um, save the project

reference_method: the Sellmeier formula itself at held-out wavelengths; hashlib.sha256 of the raw bytes; an independent evaluation of the fitted poles with omega -> (2/dt) tan(omega dt/2) for the discretization error; the second-order scaling of that error with dt

observables.name: raw_sha256
observables.definition: MaterialProvenance.raw_sha256 against hashlib.sha256 of the file bytes or the submitted text

observables.name: held_out_n_error
observables.definition: max |Re sqrt(eps_fit) - n_Sellmeier| at 97 wavelengths not in the table

observables.name: discretization_n_error
observables.definition: discretization_report max_abs_n_error at dt and at dt/2, and their ratio

observables.name: extrapolation_warning
observables.definition: MaterialBandWarning message and its presence in estimate(project)['warnings'] and /api/validate

observables.name: persisted_fields
observables.definition: provenance, fit_band_um, fit_dt_s, samples and poles after Project.save/load

acceptance_limits.provenance: raw_sha256 equals the SHA-256 of the raw bytes; source, licence, file name, columns, unit and date are kept on the Material and in the project JSON
acceptance_limits.fit: SiO2 converges within 3 poles at tolerance 1e-4; held-out n error below 2e-4 and |k| below 1e-6; the Lorentz table converges within 2 poles at 1e-6 with permittivity error below 1e-5
acceptance_limits.discretization: max_abs_n_error equals the independent bilinear evaluation to 1e-12 relative; error ratio dt over dt/2 between 3.8 and 4.2; k error below 1e-8 for the lossless table
acceptance_limits.extrapolation: a band inside the fitted band gives no warning; a band outside raises MaterialBandWarning naming both bands and the material, and the same text is in the estimate and validation warnings
acceptance_limits.failure_is_explicit: an unconverged fit is returned with converged False and require_tolerance raises
acceptance_limits.source_of_limits: G6-01 specification; the fit tolerance and error limits are fixture-specific budgets declared here before the run
